The Side-Path Companies

69 individual trainers, each with a battle portrait and eight authored walking poses. First Light wears European crusader armour. Dawn Bloom draws on the armies of Salah ad-Din.

All 69 battle portraits now match the established anime trainer style, with complete figures and visibly supported equipment. The 20 previously deferred corrections are included.
